notes.title: 0.23 New Christmas Update with new blocks, Christmas tree, features and fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]What is new in 0.23:[/h1]
- new Christmas blocks
- Christmas in home mode
- better aim with rays
- boxes can be edited
- ability to remove all surfaces in the room

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- not able to click the tutorial cancel button with hand
- fix rotation for all build-in sets
- distance grab is not lagging
- fixed visual issues in endless mode
- fix not able to turn off music in sandbox
- cannot disconnect trophies
- adding left grab pose for gun
- cannot trigger buttons with ui ray
- no progress circle when disconnecting from baseplate
- downloaded sets do not show in the library
- blocks dont get unhighligted when connected or disconnected
- workbench is not aligned to the player when game mode starts
- missing mesh on few buttons
- cannot click next button in the button group
- double studs create issues with jellify gun
- cannot change skybox and ground in endless
